about: Daonil (glibenclamide), by brand name only, is supplied six times to a 73-year-old man.
Daonil (glibenclamide) is started on 9 December 2025 for a 70-year-old woman and supplied three times, the last on 23 June 2026, in the middle of a 14-month history.
The only sulfonylurea is gliclazide (Glyade MR), which is not on the list and which the source says may be safer, so the criterion is not met.
